title: Exclusive: AIPAC Whistleblower Speaks to Zeteo
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Last week, **Zeteo** premiered its latest documentary, **' Night Flower:
Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence,' **in the Windy City of Chicago, but this
film was made for audiences around the world. So, have you watched it yet?

If you ever wondered why [AIPAC](https://zeteo.com/p/track-aipac-israel-lobby-
elections-usa-trump-maga-palestine-gaza-fraud) is not registered as a foreign
agent as many have called for, whether its power is fading, or if it helped
drag the U.S. into war with Iran, then this is the investigative documentary
you need to watch.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Featuring interviews with former AIPAC officials and insiders, as well as
high-profile and outspoken members of Congress such as Reps. Thomas Massie and
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and leading activists, this groundbreaking hour-long
film follows the influential [pro-Israel lobby](https://zeteo.com/p/aipac-
exposed-mehdi-speaks-to-authors?r=3uiw9m) from its roots as a one-man advocacy
operation to the present day, where it has directed tens of millions of
dollars into the U.S. [midterm elections](https://zeteo.com/p/this-might-be-
the-democrats-last?r=3uiw9m).

One AIPAC whistleblower who appears in 'Night Flower,' with his identity
disguised and voice changed, addresses the explosive question of whether AIPAC
should in fact register as a foreign agent for Israel.

The film, from 1st and Orchard Films, is the work of Dion Nissenbaum, a two-
time Pulitzer Prize finalist and the filmmaker behind **Zeteo 's** '[Who
Killed Shireen](https://zeteo.com/s/who-killed-shireen),' and Zach Goldbaum,
the Emmy Award-winning director behind the 2024 New York Times Opinion film
'[Meet the World's Most Honorable Bank Robbers of
Lebanon](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/02/28/opinion/lebanon-crisis-economy-
bank-robbers.html).'

To understand one of the main reasons why the U.S. political class continues
to call Israel our closest ally despite 3 years of genocide in Gaza and an
aimless and expensive war with Iran, watch the full documentary above.
